context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for 'Initialize Production Library' silently failing is fully validated. Backend endpoints GET /api/production-library/seed/status, /domains, /service-categories, /items all return HTTP 200 with expected counts (19/11/8). UI Company Standards list displays codes DW-001, DW-002, DW-003, PT-001, PT-002, PT-003, TP-001, TP-002 with proper rates (e.g., DW-001 = $2.85/SF). Import Wizard at /app/production-library?tab=import shows initialized state. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_production_library_seed.py -v
rca of the issue: Original issue: 'Initialize Production Library' button briefly showed 'Initializing...' then reverted with no data created. Root cause was that route modules read SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY at import time (module-level os.environ.get) before load_dotenv() had run, so httpx requests to Supabase hit an empty URL and silently failed. Fix (already applied in iteration 14): moved load_dotenv(override=False) to the very top of /app/backend/server.py before any route imports. Additionally ImportWizard.jsx now re-fetches /seed/status after POST /seed and validates is_seeded/schema_error before claiming success - eliminating the 'silent success' failure mode. Verified end-to-end: 8 production items with correct codes/domains/rates are seeded and visible in both the Company Standards workspace and the Import Wizard summary.
